title: Egyptian Flaxseed Frittata
description: A nutritious breakfast frittata made with flaxseed and inspired by Egyptian cuisine. This dish is packed with protein and fiber to keep you energized throughout the morning.

ingredients.name: light
ingredients.notes: used as a substitute for oil

ingredients.name: egyptian
ingredients.notes: used in place of traditional cheese

ingredients.name: flaxseed
ingredients.notes: ground and added as a nutritious topping

ingredients.name: frittata
ingredients.notes: used as the base of the dish

instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1/4 cup of light over medium heat.
Add shredded egyptian and cook until melted and slightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour egg mixture over the skillet and cook until edges start to set.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with ground flaxseed.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve hot.
